Kairne Capital Trust Pledges $500 Million for India Investments

Kairne Capital Trust has announced a new investment scheme focused on India, pledging US$500 million. The trust aims to deploy this capital into various opportunities within the Indian market. This initiative signals a significant financial commitment towards India's economic landscape.
